scope: Project-owned session protocols v1/v1.1 (ADR 0005), WASI preview 1 and independently generated fixtures. ISO 32000-2:2020 EC3 clauses 7.7.3.3 (Table 31), 7.8.2, 8.3.2.3 and 7.6.4.3.2-7.6.4.3.3 were verified in the locally supplied reference; no standard text is reproduced.

requirements.status: v1 layouts preserved; additive v1.1 viewport generations
requirements.gaps: Wire layout is project-owned and fixed in crates/pagura-host/PROTOCOL.md; no interoperability claim beyond v1.
The host fuzz target has bounded smoke runs only; no long campaigns, transport deadlines, engine-side cancellation, or OS memory-limit evidence.
Synchronous v1; no concurrent requests, handle reuse or within-request cancellation.

requirements.status: implemented for facade Error and Diagnostic fields
tests: tools/host_test.mjs structured Unsupported and strict-repair failures
requirements.gaps: No known field loss: errors preserve feature and refused repair separately, plus category/message/object/position.
Interactive pipe test validates flushing, structured failure and terminal exit; sustained I/O fault injection is separate.

requirements.status: verified for all classic render cases and page 2 of two-pages
tests: tools/host_test.mjs browser-shim pixels and partial tile rows
requirements.gaps: This is correctness evidence on the declared generated subset, not general PDF conformance or performance evidence.

requirements.status: implemented and exercised through the actual shim
requirements.gaps: Native and WASI parity plus empty args/env/preopens are exercised offline; actual touch and modal interaction require browser checks.

requirements.status: continuous lazy pages with zoom, gestures, keyboard controls and password entry
requirements.gaps: New layout, touch gestures and modal need real-browser interaction checks. The visual image roles do not provide tagged-PDF text. UTF-8 password text is supported; legacy PDFDocEncoding text conversion is not implemented in the UI.

requirements.status: verified in-process, natively, in WASI, through the browser shim and in the viewer DOM harness
requirements.gaps: Real-browser navigation verified manually. Page 1 uses two-pages.ppm; page 2 expectations are independently computed from the stated blue-square geometry, including partial tiles.

requirements.status: implemented with opt-in read-only server routes and validated startup URL loading
requirements.gaps: Serving remains loopback-only and disabled unless --fixtures is supplied; only corpus/generated is exposed.

requirements.status: session LRU with configurable accounting budget and eight-entry cap
requirements.gaps: The renderer exposes mark count but no retained heap size; weights are estimates, not a process-memory ceiling. Oversized entries are not retained.

requirements.status: additive protocol v1.1 and queued-client cancellation
requirements.gaps: An executing synchronous tile finishes; only stale queued work and its pixels are discarded. Generations do not wrap.

requirements.status: lazy continuous pages, compact height index and bounded DOM/tiles
requirements.gaps: 32 visible pages, 128 visible tiles, 256 detailed metadata entries, 200000 height records and a 10-million-CSS-pixel layout budget; excess is explicit.

requirements.status: accessible modal, wrong-password retry, cancellation and cleared temporary values
requirements.gaps: Text entry uses UTF-8. Raw byte passwords remain available through the client; non-ASCII legacy PDFDocEncoding conversion and engine SASLprep limitations remain.

requirements.status: additive v1.1 session stats and separate linear-memory sideband
requirements.gaps: Source and compiled-list estimates exclude document internals, transient allocations, transport and JS. Document retained counter has no public accessor. Linear memory is a high-water capacity, not live heap or RSS.

requirements.status: bounded automatic restart with document, password, page and zoom replay
requirements.gaps: Client-only injected traps, memory, budgets and deadlines exercise recovery; physical browser OOM and browser interaction still need runtime validation. One automatic retry per selected file. The 512 MiB memory check runs at I/O boundaries; request deadline is 30 seconds.

requirements.status: safe native flag with pre/post compilation and painting checks for generated tiles
requirements.gaps: No engine checkpoints within operators or display-list commands; no WASI bridge to the supervisor flag. Current browser generations skip queued work, and fatal deadlines terminate the execution thread.
